extracted.intended_audience: mathematicians submitting manuscripts to Acta Mathematica / Institut Mittag-Leffler
extracted.subtask_description: Publisher instructions for authors preparing and submitting research manuscripts to Acta Mathematica, including required formats, languages, copyright terms, figure policies, and resubmission procedure after acceptance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial submission: single paper copy
rubrics_metrics.description: One paper copy of the manuscript intended for publication should be sent to the Institut Mittag-Leffler address; only this one paper copy should be submitted at this stage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Electronic submission is not possible at the initial submission stage. Send the single paper copy to: Acta Mathematica, Institut Mittag-Leffler, Auravägen 17, SE-182 60 Djursholm, SWEDEN. Receipt of the submission will be acknowledged by the Institute.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow-up electronic submission to editor
rubrics_metrics.description: After receipt is acknowledged, the author will be asked to send the manuscript electronically to the editor in charge.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare to provide an electronic version when requested by the Institute/editor; initial physical submission remains required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript preparation format
rubrics_metrics.description: Normally, only manuscripts prepared using LaTeX (preferred) or TeX are accepted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should prepare their manuscripts in LaTeX (preferred) or TeX to conform with the journal's normal acceptance practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowed languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Allowable languages are English, French and German.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit the manuscript in one of the three permitted languages (English, French, German).

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright and originality requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: By submitting a manuscript, an author acknowledges that it is not being considered, nor will be submitted, for publication elsewhere, and agrees that the sole copyright is transferred to the publisher.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The transfer of copyright is revoked if and when the publisher decides not to publish the manuscript. The publisher's copyright covers the exclusive right to reproduce and distribute the article by any means (printing, reprinting, photocopying, electronic means, etc.). The publisher nevertheless grants the author the right to distribute a small number of preprints and reprints, and to have the submitted manuscript available on the author's own homepage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Colour figures policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Acta Mathematica is printed in black/white; colour figures in print require the author to contribute to the extra costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If colour figures are desired in the print journal, authors must be prepared to pay the extra costs. In the online version, colour figures will appear free of charge.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resubmission of accepted manuscripts (final version)
rubrics_metrics.description: Once the author has received notice that the manuscript has been accepted for publication, a final version should be prepared and submitted electronically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the detailed 'Instructions for authors' linked by the journal for specifics on preparing the final accepted manuscript for electronic submission.
